signals.topic: Pets bonding with people at home
signals.summary: Companion animals settling into home life alongside their owners — a warm, cozy-interior-friendly angle a synthetic persona can sustain with pets in styled rooms.
signals.why_now: The Dodo's 'Rescued Chameleon Gets Attached To Work-From-Home Dad' (~2h) and 'Dog Chained Up Her Whole Life Is Somehow Still Obsessed With People' (~20h); same single-source caveat as above.

signals.summary: Rescue-to-recovery animal stories carry the category — but this cycle they come almost entirely from one publisher, so this is a thin, single-source read.
signals.why_now: The Dodo's video stream is the only live vein this cycle (reddit rate-limited, The Dodo's RSS 404): a bloated-hedgehog rescue (~0.3h), a rescued chameleon bonding with a WFH owner (~2h) and a feral puppy that stops growling (~16h). Independent corroboration is absent.
